cross_case_assessment.conditional_signal: The accepted examples demonstrate a concrete same-query covered-versus-preserved local cue contrast with the same donor transform. The control removes simple whole-image donor-presence difference, while changed local position is intentional supervision.
cross_case_assessment.own_holes_and_ownership: The hard exclusive-alpha proof excludes other annotated visible owners and preserves holes numerically. A checkerboard in donor displays is visualization only. A partial alpha silhouette is not a full physical object model; visual RGB purity and optical ownership at resized boundaries are still uncertain.
cross_case_assessment.appearance_limits: Clearly synthetic2D pasted wood, brighter/orange donor versus dark weathered pallet, sharp/jagged edges and occasional pale fringe, absent cast/contact shadow. No photorealism or natural-foreign-occlusion claim.
cross_case_assessment.coverage_limits: All62 accepted pairs are PALLOX; LOCO has0 accepted. The inspected first3 accepted cases are all the same base03/original176 with different donors, not three independent pallets. PALLOX is clustered around the same physical source bin, and TRAIN donor images were previously source-exposed.
cross_case_assessment.not_measured: No learned accuracy, transfer improvement, coordinate correctness, native correspondence or independent-holdout performance is established.

recommendation.reason: The actual fixed accepted crops and exact numeric certificates support intentionally controlled cover/sham supervision at unchanged q. This is adequate to propose a bounded source-only augmentation role, provided failures stayU and natural/native/human truth or transfer benefit is not claimed.
